en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.684 - Abu Ja'far, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), said to Abu Hamzah al-Thumali:

"The four mosques are: the Sacred Mosque (Masjid al-Haram), the Mosque of the Messenger (Masjid al-Nabawi), the Mosque of Bayt al-Maqdis (Jerusalem), and the Mosque of Kufa.
O’ Abu Hamzah, performing an obligatory prayer in any of these mosques is equivalent to performing a pilgrimage (Hajj), and a supererogatory (optional) prayer in them is equivalent to performing an ‘Umrah (minor pilgrimage)."
